rawContent: I'm watching #CitizenRose trying to get some understanding of #RoseMcGowan's journey and the #MeToo movement. #Documentary

Fascinating that former Congressman @JackKingston thinks that 17/18 yr olds are incapable of starting a movement! Umm, heard of the #CivilRights movement? #BlackLivesMatter? Vietnam? #MalalaYousafzai? ALL young people! You need to read up on your #AmericanHistory sir!

Rant of the week. And yes take it personally. I walked past at least 15 Black students this week who DID NOT acknowledge, head nod, eye contact. Nothing. We can't be all #BlackPanther #BlackLivesMatter #BlackHistoryMonth if we can't speak to those who look like us #ThinkAboutIt
Love. Love. Love. The #HereWeAre poem! Yaaasss! #SpokenWord #GoWomen #MeToo #TimesUp #Oscars

I think it's interesting that people are poopooing #StormyDaniels when we just had this big ol #MeToo movement empowering women to tell their story. So she can't tell hers? Cause she's a porn star? If you can tell yours, she can tell hers

Every time I think about  Sacramento, I think, weapon or no weapon, police officers wear vests to protect themselves. What protects us from the rogue police officer who shoots first then asks questions? So disturbing! #StephonClark #Unjustified #BlackLivesMatter

OMG! #KendrickLamar won a #PulitzerPrize and that is awesome! #HipHop has arrived. Wow! Just goes to show that you can still be a true artist/writer/rapper all at the same time. #PopCulture at its best! #blacklivesmatter

Dear #LawEnforcement, the next time you encounter a black suspect who may have committed an actual crime, please make sure you apprehend without incident just like you did Reinking, Dylan Roof and countless other white suspects who we know actually killed people #BlackLivesMatter

Dear Men, women have started multiple movements over the past few years, #MeToo, etc. Now it's your turn. In light of this 30 year old #FailureToLaunch case, who's parents sued him to get out, men should start a movement encouraging other men NOT to be so sorry! #ImJustSayin

Just like instances of perceived racism should be examined individually, I believe that the #MeToo movement also exists on a continuum and each case should be judged separately. It cannot all be clumped together, from flirting all the way to assault, there's a lot in between.

Again, I'm down with the #MeToo movement, however, everyone knows that just because you say #PhysicalAppearance doesn't count, means that it counts. Y'all can try to reinforce that #MissAmerica but this is still #America and women are still very much judged on looks #ImJustSayin

This fool said "by touch and by feel" is how he'll know whether Kim Jun Un is someone he can work with. First, that sounds like a #MeToo moment, Second, What about leadership, diplomacy, human rights assessment. You're the leader of the free world?!? So embarrassing #45

Dear old white lady who felt empowered/privileged enough to form to call a Latino man you don't even know a rapist just goes to further prove that you don't even know how insulting it is to a man in the #MeToo era to be accused #TheWorst #UnAmerican and #RacistRants

Dear women who are #45 followers, I hope you're listening to him and his rhetoric about #ElizabethWarren, #MaxineWaters, the #MeToo movement and beyond. If that's the kind of man you like, i wish you luck because he is #TheWorst
